title: Advanced Subjunctive Mood & Formulaic Legal Registers
objective: Menguasai subjunctive formulaik (be that as it may, come what may, lest he fail) dalam register hukum dan protokol formal.

theory.summary: Subjunctive mood dalam bahasa Inggris tingkat mahir mencakup struktur formulaik yang sangat spesifik untuk register hukum, protokol diplomatik, dan wacana formal tingkat tinggi. Berbeda dari subjunctive sederhana (I suggest he be present), bentuk formulaik menggunakan inversi modal dan frasa idiomatis yang telah membeku secara sintaksis. Struktur ini sangat penting dalam drafting legal, pernyataan resmi pemerintah, dan negosiasi internasional. Penguasaan bentuk ini menandai kemampuan linguistik setara native-level professional.
rules: Formulaic subjunctive dengan inversi: Be that as it may / Come what may / Suffice it to say. Formula: [Bare infinitive + subject + complement], mengekspresikan konsesi atau ketegasan tanpa memerlukan auxiliary verb.

Mandative subjunctive dalam klausa nominal: It is imperative/essential/vital that he attend (bukan 'attends'). Formula: [Adjective of necessity + that + subject + bare infinitive]. Digunakan dalam resolusi formal, statutory requirements, dan legal mandates.

Purposive subjunctive dengan 'lest': She studied diligently lest she fail the examination. Formula: [Main clause + lest + subject + bare infinitive], menyatakan tindakan pencegahan dalam register arkais namun masih digunakan dalam konteks hukum dan sastra formal.

Conditional subjunctive dengan inversi: Were it not for / Should it be deemed / Had it been otherwise. Formula: [Auxiliary + subject + complement], menghilangkan 'if' untuk efek formal dan emphasis dalam legal argumentation.

Concessional formulaic expressions: Though he be experienced / However qualified she may be. Formula: [Subordinator + subject + bare infinitive/modal], menekankan konsesi dengan register tinggi dalam judicial opinions dan academic discourse.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Register dan Overuse dalam Konteks Informal
commonTrap.explanation: Pelajar C1 sering menggunakan subjunctive formulaik dalam konteks yang terlalu kasual, atau mencampur register formal-arkais dengan struktur modern sehingga terdengar tidak natural. Subjunctive formulaik harus dibatasi pada legal drafting, ceremonial speech, atau academic writing formal—penggunaan dalam email bisnis biasa atau presentasi informal justru terkesan bombastic dan tidak profesional.
commonTrap.wrong: Come what may, I think we should maybe reschedule the team meeting for next week if everyone's available.
commonTrap.correct: The Board resolves that the annual audit be completed by fiscal year-end, come what may, notwithstanding any operational impediments.

vocab.collocation: Wherefore, the parties respectfully request that the tribunal grant the motion for summary judgment.
The mandative subjunctive is essential in drafting statutory provisions that impose obligations.
It is imperative that all stakeholders be informed of the regulatory changes forthwith.
Suffice it to say that the evidence presented was insufficient to sustain a conviction.
The concessional clause acknowledges the defendant's cooperation, albeit limited.
Statutory interpretation requires that the subjunctive mood be preserved in legislative text.
Legal writing employs formulaic expressions to ensure precision and consistency across jurisdictions.
Should the court deem it necessary, additional testimony may be required.
Lest any impediment arise, counsel shall notify the registry within 48 hours.

dialogue.context: Seorang legislative drafter senior sedang melatih associate junior dalam menyusun draft amandemen undang-undang untuk parlemen. Mereka membahas penggunaan subjunctive mood yang tepat dalam statutory language.

lines.speaker: Senior Drafter
lines.text: When drafting this provision, it's imperative that the verb form remain in the subjunctive throughout. We write 'that each Member State ensure compliance,' not 'ensures.'
lines.translation: Saat menyusun ketentuan ini, sangat penting bahwa bentuk kata kerja tetap dalam subjunctive sepanjang teks. Kita menulis 'that each Member State ensure compliance,' bukan 'ensures.'

lines.speaker: Junior Associate
lines.text: I understand the mandative subjunctive for obligations, but what about the formulaic expressions? When should I use 'be that as it may' versus a simple concession clause?
lines.translation: Saya memahami mandative subjunctive untuk kewajiban, tetapi bagaimana dengan ekspresi formulaik? Kapan saya harus menggunakan 'be that as it may' dibanding klausa konsesi sederhana?

lines.speaker: Senior Drafter
lines.text: Use formulaic subjunctives sparingly and only when you need to convey absolute certainty or unshakeable conditions. 'Be that as it may' signals that regardless of counterarguments, the principle stands firm.
lines.translation: Gunakan subjunctive formulaik secara hemat dan hanya ketika Anda perlu menyampaikan kepastian mutlak atau kondisi yang tidak tergoyahkan. 'Be that as it may' menandakan bahwa terlepas dari argumen tandingan, prinsipnya tetap kokoh.

lines.speaker: Junior Associate
lines.text: So in this clause about emergency powers, should I write 'The Minister may act, come what may, to protect national security'?
lines.translation: Jadi dalam klausul tentang kewenangan darurat ini, haruskah saya menulis 'The Minister may act, come what may, to protect national security'?

lines.speaker: Senior Drafter
lines.text: Precisely. 'Come what may' emphasizes that no circumstance can prevent the Minister's authority. But pair it with 'notwithstanding' for additional legal clarity: 'notwithstanding any other provision.'
lines.translation: Tepat sekali. 'Come what may' menekankan bahwa tidak ada keadaan yang dapat mencegah kewenangan Menteri. Tetapi padukan dengan 'notwithstanding' untuk kejelasan hukum tambahan: 'notwithstanding any other provision.'

lines.speaker: Junior Associate
lines.text: What about the purposive subjunctive with 'lest'? I rarely see it in modern statutes. Is it still acceptable in contemporary legal drafting?
lines.translation: Bagaimana dengan purposive subjunctive menggunakan 'lest'? Saya jarang melihatnya dalam undang-undang modern. Apakah masih dapat diterima dalam penyusunan legal kontemporer?

lines.speaker: Senior Drafter
lines.text: It's archaic but not obsolete. Use 'lest' when drafting provisions that prevent harm or unintended consequences: 'Records shall be sealed lest confidential information be disclosed inadvertently.'
lines.translation: Ini arkais tetapi tidak usang. Gunakan 'lest' ketika menyusun ketentuan yang mencegah kerugian atau konsekuensi tidak diinginkan: 'Records shall be sealed lest confidential information be disclosed inadvertently.'

lines.speaker: Junior Associate
lines.text: That makes sense. Should I avoid subjunctive inversion in explanatory memoranda, though? It seems too formal for internal government documents.
lines.translation: Itu masuk akal. Haruskah saya menghindari inversi subjunctive dalam memorandum penjelasan? Tampaknya terlalu formal untuk dokumen pemerintah internal.

lines.speaker: Senior Drafter
lines.text: Absolutely correct. Reserve inversion—'were it not for,' 'should it be deemed'—for the statute itself and judicial opinions. Memoranda can use standard conditionals for readability.
lines.translation: Benar sekali. Simpan inversi—'were it not for,' 'should it be deemed'—untuk undang-undang itu sendiri dan opini pengadilan. Memorandum dapat menggunakan conditional standar untuk keterbacaan.

lines.speaker: Junior Associate
lines.text: Understood. One final question: if the committee proposes amendments, how do I ensure the subjunctive consistency isn't broken during revisions?
lines.translation: Mengerti. Satu pertanyaan terakhir: jika komite mengusulkan amandemen, bagaimana saya memastikan konsistensi subjunctive tidak rusak selama revisi?

lines.speaker: Senior Drafter
lines.text: Always review the entire provision after amendments. Look for verb concordance—every mandative clause must maintain the bare infinitive. It's tedious, but essential for legislative integrity.
lines.translation: Selalu tinjau seluruh ketentuan setelah amandemen. Periksa kesesuaian kata kerja—setiap klausa mandatif harus mempertahankan infinitive tanpa 'to'. Membosankan, tetapi penting untuk integritas legislatif.

lines.speaker: Junior Associate
lines.text: Thank you. I'll ensure that all subjunctive forms are preserved, be that as it may, even if it requires multiple rounds of proofreading.
lines.translation: Terima kasih. Saya akan memastikan semua bentuk subjunctive terjaga, bagaimanapun juga, meskipun memerlukan beberapa putaran proofreading.

speakingLab.context: Anda adalah seorang legal counsel yang sedang berlatih menyampaikan argumen formal di hadapan panel arbitrase internasional. Mr. Khoirul berperan sebagai senior arbitrator yang menguji kemampuan Anda menggunakan register hukum tingkat tinggi dengan subjunctive mood yang tepat.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good morning, Counsel. Please present your opening statement regarding the jurisdictional objection. I expect precise legal language with appropriate use of the subjunctive mood.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Good morning, Mr. Arbitrator. It is imperative that this tribunal recognize its jurisdiction over the dispute, notwithstanding the respondent's objections. The arbitration clause clearly mandates that all disputes be resolved through this forum.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Counsel, the respondent argues that your client failed to exhaust local remedies. How do you address this procedural impediment?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Be that as it may, the treaty provisions explicitly waive the requirement for exhaustion of local remedies in investment disputes. Should the tribunal deem otherwise, we respectfully submit that the local courts lack jurisdiction over treaty-based claims.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Your use of 'be that as it may' is noted. Now, regarding the damages calculation—what formula do you propose the tribunal adopt?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: We propose that the tribunal apply the DCF methodology, lest the respondent's valuation understate the actual losses suffered. It is essential that future cash flows be discounted at the appropriate risk-adjusted rate.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Very well. One final matter: should the tribunal find in your favor, what remedies do you seek, and what are the temporal constraints?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: We respectfully request that the award be issued within six months, come what may. Wherefore, we pray that the tribunal grant full compensation for all losses, together with pre-award and post-award interest as provided under the applicable rules.

quiz.question: It is imperative that every witness ___ the oath before providing testimony in these proceedings.
quiz.explanation: Setelah frasa mandative seperti 'it is imperative that', kita harus menggunakan bare infinitive (subjunctive mood) tanpa tambahan -s atau auxiliary. 'Take' adalah bentuk yang benar, bukan 'takes' atau 'will take'. Ini adalah aturan baku dalam legal English dan statutory drafting.

quiz.question: The parties negotiated diligently ___ any misunderstanding arise during implementation of the settlement agreement.
quiz.explanation: 'Lest' adalah conjunction yang digunakan dalam purposive subjunctive untuk menyatakan tindakan pencegahan dalam register formal/hukum. Strukturnya adalah 'lest + subject + bare infinitive'. Meskipun 'in case' secara makna mirip, 'lest' adalah pilihan yang tepat untuk register legal formal tingkat C1.

quiz.question: ___ for the court's intervention, the defendant would have concealed material evidence from discovery.
quiz.explanation: Dalam conditional subjunctive formal dengan inversi, kita menghilangkan 'if' dan menempatkan auxiliary di depan subject: 'Were it not for' (bukan 'If it were not'). Ini adalah struktur baku dalam legal argumentation dan judicial opinions untuk emphasis dan register formal.

quiz.question: The tribunal's decision stands firm, ___, regardless of the dissenting opinion filed by one arbitrator.
quiz.explanation: 'Be that as it may' adalah formulaic subjunctive expression yang menyatakan konsesi dengan register sangat formal. Frasa ini membeku secara sintaksis dan digunakan dalam legal writing, diplomatic correspondence, dan formal academic discourse untuk menunjukkan bahwa prinsip tetap berlaku terlepas dari argumen tandingan.

quiz.question: The emergency protocol stipulates that all personnel ___ evacuated immediately, ___, should a chemical leak be detected.
quiz.explanation: Kombinasi 'be' (mandative subjunctive setelah 'stipulates that') dan 'come what may' (formulaic subjunctive untuk menyatakan ketegasan mutlak) adalah pilihan paling tepat untuk register formal statutory provisions. 'Come what may' menekankan bahwa tidak ada kondisi yang dapat menghalangi pelaksanaan protokol.

quiz.question: Notwithstanding the respondent's objections, this court finds that the plaintiff ___ entitled to equitable relief under the circumstances.
quiz.explanation: Setelah 'finds that' dalam context judicial determination, terutama ketika dipasangkan dengan 'notwithstanding' (register sangat formal), subjunctive 'be' lebih tepat daripada indicative 'is' untuk menekankan sifat deklaratif dan authoritative dari putusan pengadilan. Ini adalah nuansa tingkat C1 dalam legal writing.
